Bar plots of impact x race

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)

#----------------------------
# 1. Reshape race indicators long
#----------------------------
race_impact_long <- data_full %>%
  dplyr::select(all_of(race_vars), all_of(impact_vars)) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(race_vars),
    names_to = "race_var",
    values_to = "in_race"
  ) %>%
  filter(in_race == 1) %>%
  mutate(
    race = recode(race_var, !!!race_labels)
  )

#----------------------------
# 2. Plot ANY impact by race
#----------------------------
impact_by_race <- race_impact_long %>%
  group_by(race) %>%
  summarise(
    pct_impacted = mean(impact, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_race = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(impact_by_race, aes(x = fct_reorder(race, pct_impacted), y = pct_impacted)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Share with any impact",
    title = "Proportion of each racial group with any carceral contact"
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  theme_minimal()

impact_by_race_type <- race_impact_long %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(impact_vars),
    names_to = "impact_var",
    values_to = "has_impact"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    impact_type = recode(impact_var, !!!impact_labels)
  ) %>%
  group_by(race, impact_type) %>%
  summarise(
    pct = mean(has_impact, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

ggplot(impact_by_race_type, aes(x = race, y = pct, fill = impact_type)) +
  geom_col(position = position_dodge(width = 0.8)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1)) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Share within racial group",
    fill = NULL,
    title = "Sample Carceral Contact by Race"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

Turning above into 4 tables

library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)

# race vars and labels
race_vars <- c("White", "Black", "Hisp_Latino", "OtherRace")

race_labels <- c(
  White = "White",
  Black = "Black",
  Hisp_Latino = "Hisp_Latino",
  OtherRace = "Other Race"
)

impact_vars <- c("impact", "incarc", "knowincarc", "vict")

impact_labels <- c(
  impact = "Any Impact",
  incarc = "Direct",
  knowincarc = "Proximal",
  vict = "Victim"
)

# function: one table for one racial group
make_race_impact_table <- function(race_var) {
  
  dat_race <- data_full %>%
    dplyr::filter(.data[[race_var]] == 1)
  
  race_n <- nrow(dat_race)
  
  tibble(
    Impact = unname(impact_labels),
    n = purrr::map_int(impact_vars, ~ sum(dat_race[[.x]] == 1, na.rm = TRUE))
  ) %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      pct = round(100 * n / race_n, 1),
      `n (%)` = sprintf("%d (%.1f\\%%)", n, pct)
    ) %>%
    dplyr::select(Impact, `n (%)`)
}

# create all four tables as a named list
race_impact_tables <- setNames(
  lapply(race_vars, make_race_impact_table),
  unname(race_labels)
)

# view one example
race_impact_tables[["White"]]
race_impact_tables[["Black"]]
race_impact_tables[["Hispanic"]]

Econ Experiences Across Impact Groups

economic_vars <- c(
  "snap",
  "medicaid",
  "unemployed",
  "uninsured"
)

economic_impact_summary <- purrr::map_dfr(
  economic_vars,
  function(var) {
    
    data_full %>%
      filter(.data[[var]] == 1) %>%
      summarise(
        variable = var,
        n_group = n(),
        
        incarc_n = sum(incarc == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
        incarc_prop = mean(incarc == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
        
        knowincarc_n = sum(knowincarc == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
        knowincarc_prop = mean(knowincarc == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
        
        vict_n = sum(vict == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
        vict_prop = mean(vict == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
        
        impact_n = sum(impact == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
        impact_prop = mean(impact == 1, na.rm = TRUE),
        
        no_impact_n = sum(impact == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
        no_impact_prop = mean(impact == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
      )
  }
)

economic_impact_summary



economic_impact_plot <- economic_impact_summary %>%
  dplyr::select(
    variable,
    incarc_prop,
    knowincarc_prop,
    vict_prop,
    impact_prop,
    no_impact_prop
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -variable,
    names_to = "impact_type",
    values_to = "proportion"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    impact_type = recode(
      impact_type,
      incarc_prop = "Direct",
      knowincarc_prop = "Proximal",
      vict_prop = "Victim",
      impact_prop = "Any Impact",
      no_impact_prop = "No Impact"
    ),
    impact_type = factor(
      impact_type,
      levels = c(
        "Direct",
        "Proximal",
        "Victim",
        "Any Impact",
        "No Impact"
      )
    )
  )

economic_impact_plot 
NA

make_economic_plot <- function(var_name, plot_title) {
  
  economic_impact_plot %>%
    filter(variable == var_name) %>%
    ggplot(
      aes(
        x = impact_type,
        y = proportion
      )
    ) +
    geom_col() +
    geom_text(
      aes(label = scales::percent(proportion, accuracy = 0.1)),
      vjust = -0.4
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      labels = scales::percent,
      limits = c(0, 0.6)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = plot_title,
      x = NULL,
      y = "Proportion of Group Reporting Yes"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(
        angle = 30,
        hjust = 1
      )
    )
}

plot_snap <- make_economic_plot(
  "snap",
  "SNAP Recipients"
)

plot_medicaid <- make_economic_plot(
  "medicaid",
  "Medicaid Recipients"
)

plot_unemployed <- make_economic_plot(
  "unemployed",
  "Unemployed Respondents"
)

plot_uninsured <- make_economic_plot(
  "uninsured",
  "Uninsured Respondents"
)


# Create a folder for figures if you don't already have one
